summary: Completed comprehensive testing of V-Chron healthcare attendance MVP. Both backend APIs and frontend UI are working correctly with full integration.

design_issues.issue: Location access denied warning shown when GPS permission not granted
design_issues.description: Shows 'Location access denied. Enable for accurate tracking' - this is expected behavior in test environment

passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero section and 4 feature cards
Registration page loads with all form fields and dropdowns
All 47 healthcare facilities available in facility dropdown
All 12 positions available in position dropdown
Login page displays correctly with email/password and Google OAuth options
Dashboard displays user information (name, position, facility, status)
Report for Duty and End Shift buttons are present and functional
Attendance history page loads and is accessible
Admin dashboard access control works (redirects unauthorized users)
Backend API endpoints all returning correct responses
Attendance creation (login/logout) works with GPS coordinates
Admin endpoints properly restrict access to non-admin users
